PROJECTS 
 
Hospital Management System 
The Hospital Management System is a full-stack web application developed using Django that streamlines and digitizes hospital administrative tasks. 
The system is designed to manage critical functionalities such as patient registration, appointment scheduling, medical history tracking, billing, and doctor 
directory management in a secure and efficient manner . The project aims to reduce manual effort, eliminate data redundancy, and improve accessibility 
for hospital staff and administrators. It features an intuitive user interface with responsive design for both desktop and mobile platforms. 
Tech stack : Django(Python), MongoDB, HTML, CSS, Javascript 
Hackathon Portal System 
Developed a Hackathon Event Management System that simplifies real-time event organization in colleges by automating student registrations, participant 
tracking, waitlisting, and cancellations. Implemented using Spring Boot, REST APIs, Spring Data JPA, and MySQL with a well -structured layered 
architecture (Controller-Service-Repository). Enabled administrators to manage hackathon details and enforce capacity limits, improving efficiency and 
reducing manual errors in event management. Integrated user-specific and event-specific data retrieval to enhance transparency and user experience. 
Tech stack : HTML, Java, Spring-Boot 
Farm Mart System 
The Farm Mart System is a web-based application designed to connect farmers directly with consumers, eliminating the need for middlemen and 
ensuring fair pricing. It allows farmers to list and manage their agricultural products, while consumers can browse, view details, and purchase fresh 
produce easily. The platform focuses on transparency, trust, and quality by showcasing farm-fresh goods with clear product information. Users can 
securely log in to access protected features such as product uploads and buying options. Overall, the system promotes sustainable agriculture and 
supports local farmers through a simple and user friendly digital marketplace. 
Tech stack : HTML, CSS, React js, Node js
